It’s time for an Audi vs Audi head-to-head! 

We’ve got our hands on the all-new Audi RS5, and it’s lining up against the almighty Audi RS6 GT! 

The RS5 may be the newest car here, but it has one key difference to the RS6 GT - it’s powered by a V6 hybrid system, while the RS6 GT is packing a twin-turbo V8! But which will come out on top? Let’s take a closer look at the stats…
